scope: Independent review of four newly filled storage geometry rows; six prior rows locked.

NOR.independently_read: GF official release 2023-09-27, ESF3 complete bitcell bullet and GF 28SLPe identity
NOR.microchip_limit: Strictly less than 0.05 um2; not an exact measured 0.05 value
NOR.boundary: Manufacturer bitcell geometry, not die capacity/area; independently programmable binary storage capped at one bit

PCM.independently_read: Original PDF p2 ePCM pulse programming section and visually rendered Fig1 full 1T1R FD-SOI stack
PCM.binary_geometry_anchor: Official ST Arnaud IEDM2018 presentation slide11 gives PCM cell 0.036 um2; binary SET(1)/RESET(0) mechanism at slide7. Selector physical gate 30nm at slide12 is not normalization F=28nm.
PCM.MLC_rule: 10 resistance states and their encoding are excluded; no factor10 or log2(10).
PCM.identity_limit: A 28nm FD-SOI 1T1R geometry reference, not reconstructed area or preserved throughput of the existing 40nm voltage-mode CIM implementation.
PCM.publisher_correction_access: Original correction PDF independently read: DOI10.1038/s44335-025-00019-3 only adds missing Data Availability statements for several articles; no geometry change.

RRAM_original.layout_limit: Original shown layout is m=4 and relative 30.3% overhead; not absolute m=1 area. New tile remains a conditional geometric model.

FeRAM_original.overlap: MFM capacitor directly on top of access transistor
FeRAM_original.geometry_limit: Cap area alone is not full bitcell. Any public 130nm access/routing rule envelope is an explicit compatible engineering reference, not Sony extracted layout.
FeRAM_original.extended_source_read: Original 6-page JEDS paper (Scispace-hosted copy), PDF p2 explicitly 130nm CMOS and capacitor areas .4/.6/.8/1.0um2; capacitor directly above transistor
FeRAM_original.access_reference: SkyWater SKY130 nfet_g5v0d10v5; a public geometry/voltage-domain reference, not Sony foundry reproduction
FeRAM_original.access_dimension_condition: L=.5um matches published 7/.5 and .42/.5 characterized devices. W=1um is explicit engineering choice, not an extracted Sony dimension.
FeRAM_original.electrical_boundary: Vth=.937 max comes from narrow .42/.5 table, not measured W1/.5. No claimed new time, current, or polarization verification.
